title: 第二十章：她真的是少爷（下）
content_zh:
一道声音传来，虽然声音沙哑，但是每个字都听得特别清楚，更让人有种亲切的感觉，犹如亲人长辈在耳边知冷问暖一般。

    贺峰一听到这道很有特色的声音，便想起了昨天自己与金灿等人打架时，便有这么一道声音传来，再看眼前这道娇小的倩影，便又想起了就是眼前这么个人，昨天一直指着自己喊着“黑马小子”，不过，当时她的声音却是有些沙哑，不想今日又变成了这般灵动悦耳，一时间倒让贺峰没有想起她来。

    转过头来，却不见昨天那个面如冠玉的素袍书生，而是看到一个依然还在贺峰身后，正向着贺峰这个方向赶来的一位少年，贺峰看到他的第一感觉就是瘦，特别瘦。不过，贺峰却又有些迷惑，昨天的时候，是自己眼前这个小姑娘的声音嘶哑，现在却又变成了眼前这个少年，莫非有什么药物，是可以让人的声音变得嘶哑的？虽然贺峰对变声没什么兴趣，但他却对这种药物很感兴趣。

    “林叔叔，昨天我就是这样喊他的，他也没说不能喊，也没告诉我他的名字，又不是我不喊”这个被称为少爷的人很是大气的解释着。

    “这位小哥儿，我家少爷并无恶意，还请小哥儿不要介意，敢问小哥儿真名？”那个被称为林叔叔的少年对着自家少爷微微一笑，而后对着贺峰轻声说道，实则他已经知道了贺峰的名字以及家庭背景，但两不相识的人，贸然上来叫破别人的名讳，道破别人的家底，这不是在表达自己的善意，而是一种挑战，甚至是蔑视。

    贺峰满脸含笑，心想：这大户人家就是够高档，连说话都是这么的客气，这一声声的小哥儿，真是喊到心窝窝里了，在瞥一眼还站在自己身前的小丫头，心中暗笑，那岂不是说自己要比她高那么小小的一辈儿？面对这么讲究的少年，贺峰也终于决定牺牲一次，文艺一次，双手一拱，算是回礼，然后很是斯文的说道：“这位大哥请了，小弟名叫贺峰，敢问大哥名讳？还有这个小姑娘是什么人？”

    那个瘦瘦的少年听到贺峰竟然喊自己大哥，眼角不禁抽了抽，也好在他的真实年龄并不像面相上看到的这般年少，否则他说不定会忍不住上前踹贺峰两脚，然后再骂上两句，这小屁孩，喊你声小哥儿是在跟你称兄道弟吗？知道老夫是谁吗？就敢来喊老夫一声大哥？

    不过，或许是太久没有人这样对自己说过话，那少年像是发现了什么有趣的事一般，笑着回了一声：“为兄林景深，这是我家少爷韵儿”

    “少爷，少爷，吓死我了，我还以为你走丢了呢”就在这时，月儿急匆匆的跑了过来，手里还拿着一大堆特意给贺峰买了的吃的和玩的。

    “月儿姐，我在••••••”贺峰笑着回应，只是话刚说到一半，就愕然回首，像是见鬼了一般的看着已经回到了林景深旁边的那个叫做韵儿的小姑娘，刚才他就觉得好像有什么不对劲的地方，但却又想不起来哪里不对，现在经过月儿的这一提醒，才猛然发现，眼前这个小姑娘竟然被人称作“少爷”，本来昨天的时候，贺峰也曾听到他自称“少爷”，但听到她后面说的带有调侃意味的话语，便觉得她是在拿自己寻开心，竟没想到，人家真真的是一位“少爷”。

    贺峰看着面前这个作女儿装扮，就连名字都这么有女人味儿的少爷，心底不禁升起一阵恶寒，恶狠狠的想道：难道这个世界就真的这么开放？还能不能让人开心地活下去了？试想，若是有一天自己突然发现自己心中暗恋已久的女神，竟然一直都是在男扮女装，那该是一件多么让人*蛋的一件事啊！
content_en:
A voice came. Although the voice was hoarse, every word was heard very clearly, which made people feel more cordial, just like relatives and elders talking to each other in their ears.

    As soon as He Feng heard this distinctive voice, he remembered that there was such a voice when he was fighting with Jin Can and others yesterday. Looking at the petite figure in front of him, he remembered that it was the person in front of him who had been pointing at him and shouting "Dark Horse Boy" yesterday. However, her voice was a little hoarse at that time. Unexpectedly, it had become so smart and sweet today, which made He Feng not think of her for a while.

    When he turned around, he didn't see the scholar in plain robes with a beautiful face from yesterday. Instead, he saw a young man who was still behind He Feng and rushing towards He Feng. The first thing He Feng felt when he saw him was that he was thin, very thin. However, He Feng was a little confused. Yesterday, the little girl in front of him had a hoarse voice, and now it turned into the young man in front of him. Is there any medicine that can make people's voices hoarse? Although He Feng had no interest in changing his voice, he was very interested in this drug.

    "Uncle Lin, that's how I called him yesterday. He didn't say not to call, nor did he tell me his name. It's not that I don't call him." The man known as the young master explained grandly.

    "This little brother, my young master does not mean any harm. Please don't mind me. Dare you ask me your real name?" The young man known as Uncle Lin smiled at his young master, and then said softly to He Feng. In fact, he already knew He Feng's name and family background. However, for strangers to come forward and call out other people's names and reveal other people's family background, this is not an expression of goodwill, but a challenge or even contempt.

    With a smile on his face, He Feng thought to himself: This wealthy family is so high-end, and even their words are so polite. The shouts of the little brother are really deep in the heart. When he glanced at the little girl who was still standing in front of him, he smiled secretly in his heart. Doesn't that mean that he is a little higher than her? Facing such a fastidious young man, He Feng finally decided to sacrifice once for arts and culture. He arched his hands as a return gift, and then said very politely: "This eldest brother has invited me. My younger brother's name is He Feng. May I ask my eldest brother's name? And who is this little girl?"

    The skinny boy couldn't help but twitch his eyes when he heard He Feng actually calling him brother. Fortunately, his real age is not as young as his appearance suggests, otherwise he might not be able to help but step forward and kick He Feng in the feet, and then curse a few words. This little kid, are you calling you brother by calling him brother? Do you know who I am? Do you dare to call me big brother?

    However, perhaps it was too long since anyone had spoken to him like this. The young man seemed to have discovered something interesting and replied with a smile: "Brother Lin Jingshen, this is my young master Yun'er."

    "Master, Master, you scared me to death. I thought you were lost." At this moment, Yue'er hurried over, holding a lot of food and toys specially bought for He Feng.

    "Sister Yue'er, I'm..." He Feng responded with a smile, but just in the middle of the sentence, he looked back in shock, as if he had seen a ghost, looking at the little girl named Yun'er who had returned to Lin Jingshen's side. Just now, he felt that something was wrong, but he couldn't remember what was wrong. Now after passing After Yue'er's reminder, he suddenly realized that the little girl in front of him was actually called "Young Master". Yesterday, He Feng had heard him call himself "Young Master", but when he heard the ridiculing words she said later, he felt that she was just making fun of him. Unexpectedly, he was really a "Young Master".

    He Feng looked at the young master in front of him who was pretending to be a daughter, and even his name was so feminine, he couldn't help but feel a chill in his heart, and thought viciously: Is this world really so open? Can people still live happily? Just imagine, if one day you suddenly find out that the goddess you have been secretly in love with for a long time has been pretending to be a man, how disgusting it would be!
title_en: Chapter 20: She is really the young master (Part 2)
